create.title: Finite M=1 endpoint boundary Cauchy reduction
create.statement_tex: For each radial endpoint xi in {1,N_X}, let E_(xi,v)(w)=epsilon_xi e(sqrt(X xi)) xi^(w-3/4-v/2)/(w-3/4-v/2), with epsilon_(N_X)=1 and epsilon_1=-1. On the finite Round-19 radial rectangle, terminal plus oriented sides plus the artificial-pole residue equals the original right-line endpoint integral minus the arithmetic-pole residue: T_xi+S_xi+P_xi=D_xi-A_xi. The artificial residue cancels only with the opposite R_1 residue; the unsplit arithmetic residue recombines as R^ar[G]-sum_xi A_xi=R^ar[R_1]. If the artificial and arithmetic poles collide, their single double-pole derivative residue replaces the two simple residues. No horizontal side or outside limit is suppressed.
create.next_action: Use the right-line endpoint-prefix formula with the exact outside profile; do not count split artificial or arithmetic residues twice.

create.title: Target-safe lower radial endpoint
create.statement_tex: After the symmetric Perron and smooth-height limits, the xi=1 right-line endpoint is -e(sqrt X)/2 times the accepted direct profile H^prof_(U,X)(1,1). Hence its normalized size is O(log X), uniformly in the symmetric top truncation, and after restoring the external X^(1/4) M1 factor its physical size is O(X^(1/4)log X). Endpoint integration-by-parts coefficients remain full; the half weight occurs only in the inverse-Perron equality case.
create.next_action: Treat the lower radial endpoint as target-safe; retain the upper endpoint and residue ledger separately.

create.title: Signed upper radial endpoint-prefix estimate
create.statement_tex: Prove uniformly in the symmetric top-profile truncation that sum_(hq<=N_X)^* chi_4(q)(hq)^(-3/4) H^prof_(U,X)(h,q) <<_epsilon X^epsilon, with N_X=floor(16sqrt X) and every actual scale, height floor, Vaaler factor, and stationary endpoint star retained. In the profile limit its grouped coefficient is exactly C_X^*(n) from GAR, but the radial phase e(sqrt(Xn)) is replaced by the constant endpoint phase e(sqrt(XN_X)); it is a full dephased prefix, not a thin endpoint subtotal. The direct-profile pointwise bound gives only the triangle-inequality capacity O(N_X^(1/4)log^2 X)=O(X^(1/8)log^2 X), which becomes O(X^(3/8)log^2 X) after restoring the external X^(1/4) M1 factor and is not target-sized.
create.next_action: First recombine the dephased prefix with the R_1 arithmetic and transition package and test whether the variable GAR phase is restored; treat a standalone prefix theorem as a stronger alternative, not an easier endpoint estimate.

create.title: Absolute upper endpoint capacity misses the physical target
create.statement_tex: At finite radial height the off-centred Perron factor is not sharply supported; in the symmetric limit it selects the full prefix hq<N_X plus the half tie. The accepted pointwise profile bound and triangle inequality yield only N_X^(1/4)log^2 X on the normalized radial scale. Since active M1 carries the external X^(1/4) factor, this is X^(3/8)log^2 X physically. The arithmetic-residue recombination removes only the split E_1 residue share and does not cancel the endpoint prefix. Thus absolute endpoint summation or treating the endpoint as only hq=N_X cannot prove the target estimate.
create.next_action: Require chi_4-sensitive cancellation in the full actual-profile prefix or a cancellation identity with another explicitly retained term.

update.statement_tex: For M=1, finite Cauchy algebra returns the terminal-plus-side endpoint operator to an original-sector right-line Perron prefix, minus the arithmetic and artificial residue shares. The lower radial endpoint is target-safe. The upper endpoint requires M9-M1-upper-radial-endpoint-prefix; absolute summation gives only physical size X^(3/8)log^2 X. The arithmetic residue recombines to R^ar[R_1] and the two diagonal transition traces remain separate. Control all of these before declaring the endpoint boundary operator closed.
update.next_action: Attack the signed upper endpoint prefix and the recombined R_1 arithmetic residue as distinct interfaces; do not infer a bound from the exact Cauchy return.

update.statement_tex: The renormalized radial sides are removed, and the M=1 endpoint boundary now has an exact finite Cauchy return. Its lower endpoint is target-safe, while the upper original-sector prefix, recombined R_1 arithmetic residue, and both diagonal transition traces remain open. The upper prefix has only physical X^(3/8)log^2 X absolute capacity and needs a normalized X^epsilon signed bound.
update.next_action: Resolve the signed upper radial endpoint prefix, then return to the recombined arithmetic residue and diagonal transition traces.

reject.reason: At finite radial height the off-centred Perron kernel is nonzero beyond hq<=xi; sharp prefix support and half ties arise only after a justified symmetric limit.
The endpoint subtraction coefficients have full weight; the half weight belongs only to the symmetric inverse-Perron equality case.
The reflected evaluation occurs near Re s=1/4, outside absolute convergence; the intact functional equation is meromorphic but its dual Dirichlet series cannot be expanded there.
The X^(1/8) bound is on the normalized GAR scale; restoring the external X^(1/4) factor yields X^(3/8), not X^(1/4+epsilon).
The arithmetic ledger cancels only its split E_1 residue share and recombines to R^ar[R_1]; it does not cancel the right-line endpoint prefix.
